# Conflict Rule 7 ## The Underground is a Faction
[italic][color=#b8860b]The Underground Black Market is a neutral faction led by the Godfather. The TSF is incentivized through Bounties to go after the UBM's memberes. The PDV considers some of them to be heretics.[/color][/italic]
- [color=#d93c3c][bold]Being Underground is not a reason to attack.[/bold][/color] You need an RP reason and escalation, like in any other conflict. -- The UBM's dealings with the Reavers are not a reason either.
- [bold]Heat.[/bold] Your PDA shows the Underground's Heat: QUIET, WATCHED, WANTED or RAID. It rises with the jobs the UBM sells and falls when it lies low. -- The warrant on each member grows with the jobs they sell themself.
- [bold]Wanted means alive.[/bold] The TSF bounty on a Fugitive, a Fixer or the Godfather is paid for a live prisoner. Make a [textlink="clear demand" link="MonolithRuleConflictThreeFairPlay"] and give them [color=#b8860b][bold]10 seconds[/bold][/color]. -- Use force if they refuse or run. Use lethal force only if they fight back. -- You can disable a ship that runs. Don't destroy it or kill its crew unless they shoot back. -- The one exception is a raid on the UBM while its Heat is RAID, or a strike that admins have allowed. Its defenders can be killed like any faction outpost's members.
- [bold]Bail Comes First.[/bold] The first time a TSF pallet sees a captured member it holds them for [color=#b8860b][bold]5 minutes[/bold][/color] and informs the Underground of the bail. If the bail is paid, the thalers land beside the prisoner. Take them and let the prisoner go. -- Bail is 200 thalers for each military credit of the warrant: at most [color=#b8860b][bold]30,000 thalers[/bold][/color] for a Fugitive, [color=#b8860b][bold]50,000 thalers[/bold][/color] for a Fixer and [color=#b8860b][bold]80,000 thalers[/bold][/color] for the Godfather.
- [bold]One capture per hour.[/bold] After an Underground member is turned in, bailed out or killed, leave that player alone for [color=#b8860b][bold]1 hour[/bold][/color]. -- No pallet takes them during that hour. -- This ends if they attack you.
- [bold]The Underground Station is a Faction Outpost.[/bold] It falls under [textlink="Conflict Rule 4" link="MonolithRuleConflictFourPortStriking"], but the war level never opens it. It can only be struck while the Underground's Heat is [color=#d93c3c][bold]RAID[/bold][/color], or with [color=#b8860b]admin permission[/color]. -- A raid window lasts 20 minutes and is announced to the sector. When it closes, break off and leave. -- Outside a raid, going aboard to make a capture is a strike. Catch them out in the sector. -- Don't camp, destroy, or make its cryo and spawn rooms uninhabitable.
- [bold]Market Truce.[/bold] Any ship the Underground has invited to dock or given a market pass is a guest, TSF and PDV ships included. Guests and the Underground don't attack each other while the ship is there. -- If a guest breaks the truce, the Underground can declare a Vendetta on the radio and attack that crew without further escalation for [color=#b8860b][bold]30 minutes[/bold][/color].
- [bold]The Underground is for Hire.[/bold] Anyone can hire it for smuggling, theft, extraction, information and sabotage of ships, even while the war level is COLD. -- It can't be hired to kill faction members or to strike an outpost (see [textlink="Conflict Rule 5" link="WGRuleConflictFiveDeclaringWar"]).
- [bold]The Godfather is the UBM's Faction Leader.[/bold] Fixers and Fugitives answer to the Godfather, who falls under the [textlink="commander rule" link="MonolithRuleRoleplayNineCommandingRoles"]. Fixers are next in line. -- Don't give away or sell the station's position, and don't hand your own people in for the bounty. That is [textlink="role abandonment" link="MonolithRuleRoleplayEightFactionRoles"].
- [bold]Marked Heretics.[/bold] An Underground member the PDV has marked is covered by the heretic lines in [textlink="Conflict Rule 1" link="MonolithRuleConflictOneRandomDeathmatch"].
